description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayer component, specifically testing the creation and error handling of WebAudioPlayer objects within the Rialto server. It uses Google Test framework to verify correct behavior and exception throwing under various invalid conditions.

classes.name: RialtoServerCreateWebAudioPlayerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for WebAudioPlayer creation tests, inheriting from WebAudioPlayerTestBase.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Test that a WebAudioPlayer object can be created successfully with valid parameters.

methods.name: InvalidPcmConfig
methods.description: Test that creating a WebAudioPlayer with a null PCM configuration throws a runtime error.

methods.name: InvalidBytesPerFrame
methods.description: Test that creating a WebAudioPlayer with zero channels (bytes per frame) throws a runtime error.

methods.name: InvalidMimeType
methods.description: Test that creating a WebAudioPlayer with an unsupported MIME type throws a runtime error.

methods.name: MainThreadFailure
methods.description: Test that failure to obtain the main thread results in a runtime error.

methods.name: MapPartitionFailure
methods.description: Test that failure to map the shared memory partition results in a runtime error.

methods.name: GetBufferFailure
methods.description: Test that failure to get the shared buffer pointer results in a runtime error.

methods.name: GetDataOffsetFailure
methods.description: Test that failure to get the data offset from shared memory results in a runtime error.

methods.name: GetMaxDataLenFailure
methods.description: Test that failure to get maximum data length results in a runtime error.

methods.name: GstPlayerFailure
methods.description: Test that failure to create the GST WebAudioPlayer results in a runtime error.
